name: site-studio
description: Set up, build, check, preview and publish a person's own portfolio or resume site on GitHub Pages, from their private dev repo. Adds work, captures references, imports a public profile, and reviews copy, looks and privacy before anything goes public; it publishes only when the person types /site-studio:publish and confirms. Use for any work on a personal site. Not for job applications, outreach or tracking a search (jobsearch).

metadata.versioningPolicy: Explicit releases; version reflects the release group's largest change (minor/patch). Bump before any sync or push — an unbumped change ships nothing and looks like a broken install.
metadata.provides: 6 agents, 11 skills (setup, adopt, publish user-only), hooks/hooks.json (SessionStart doctor+sync_main; PreToolUse publish_guard). Data: the person's dev repo, site/site.json schema 1. Contracts: spec/roster.json, docs/plugin-agent-contract.md
